}}'''Eldaya Tolen''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Blue Ajah]] raised to the [[Amyrlin Seat]] in the year {{Ne|533}}.

==History==
Eldaya held the position for sixteen years until her death in {{Ne|549}}. She was [[Beryl Marle]]'s successor and [[Alvera Ramosanya]]'s predecessor.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

She was not weak but not strong either. She left [[White Tower|Tower]] affairs to the [[Hall]] as long as she was able to manage her own manipulations elsewhere, which she did quite a lot.
